export_guide.title: Export instructions
export_guide.select_datatypes_first: First choose what you want to import to see the export steps.
export_guide.fallback: Look for an Export or Data Transfer feature inside {{platform}} and export a CSV file for {{dataType}}. Upload that file in the next step.
export_guide.csv_note: For your own CSV or Excel files, download our templates in the next step. Required columns for products are name, sku and price. Separate multiple tags or images with a pipe (|).

customers: Select "CSV for Excel, Numbers, or other spreadsheet programs".
Click "Export customers" and download the file.
products: Choose "All products" or your current selection.
Select the CSV format for Excel.
Download the file — variants appear as extra rows below the parent product.
orders: Filter by the date range you want to export.
Choose CSV and download the file.
categories: Shopify does not export a separate category list.
Categories live in the "Product Category" and "Type" columns of your product export.
Upload your products CSV — SellQo will create the categories automatically.

customers: Optionally install the free "Customer/Order/Coupon Export" plugin.
Select which customers you want to export.
products: Select all products and the fields you need.
orders: Use the "Export" button or the Order Export plugin.
Choose the date range and download the CSV.
categories: Use the "WP All Export" plugin or Tools → Export with taxonomy "product_cat".
coupons: Use the export button or the Coupon Export plugin.

customers: Go to Admin → System → Data Transfer → Export.
products: Go to Admin → System → Data Transfer → Export.
orders: Select orders or filter by date.
Click "Export" at the top and choose CSV.
categories: Magento does not export categories through the admin by default.
Use a third-party module or export your products and rebuild the tree in SellQo.
coupons: Go to Admin → Marketing → Promotions → Cart Price Rules.
Export via the Actions button or System → Data Transfer.

customers: Go to Back Office → Customers → Customers.
Click the Export icon (CSV) in the top right.
products: Go to Back Office → Catalog → Products.
orders: Go to Back Office → Orders → Orders.
categories: Go to Back Office → Catalog → Categories.
coupons: Go to Back Office → Catalog → Discounts → Cart Rules.
Click "Export" in the top right and download the CSV.

customers: eCom: Back Office → Tools → Exports → Customers. Retail: Reports → Customers → Export.
products: eCom: Back Office → Tools → Exports → Products. Retail: Reports → Inventory → Export.
orders: eCom: Back Office → Tools → Exports → Orders. Retail: Reports → Sales → Export.
categories: eCom: Back Office → Tools → Exports → Categories.
coupons: eCom: Back Office → Marketing → Discount codes → Export (when available).
